rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for proximity or something being near.

example.english: Is there a subway station in the vicinity of your home?
example.traditional: 你屋企附近有冇地鐵站？
example.jyutping: nei5 uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6 jau5 mou5 dei6 tit3 zaam6

rows.note: Use this for the broader surrounding area or neighbourhood rather than simple proximity.

example.english: The vicinity is very quiet at night.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zau1 wai4 je6 maan5 hou2 zing6
